|{1:* Links}|
|A {2:described link} in text.|
|A bare {2:https://neovim.io} link.|
|A plain {3:https://example.com/path} link.|
|A {2:file link} and {4:<<target>>}.|
|A footnote{5:[fn:1]} and a {6:radio} {4:<<<radio>>>} target.|

{1} OrgHeadlineLevel1 -> Title [bold]
{2} OrgLink -> @markup.link [underline]
{3} orgLinkPlain -> OrgLink -> @markup.link [underline]
{4} OrgTarget -> Underlined [underline]
{5} OrgFootnote -> Underlined [underline]
{6} orgRadioLink -> OrgLink -> @markup.link [underline]
